board-push.description: Board file changes (index.html, tasks.json, board.css, tests/synthetic_matrix.js): publish via push_board.py --publish, which enforces the regression suite in code and syncs repo + portal KV.

github-repo-push-tag.description: Script/tool repos with no live web deploy (trading, short-video, vehicle, cross-thread scripts): commit+push via GitHub Contents API, release tag on the commit. The tag marks exactly which commit the release came from. Verification reads the tagged blob back through the API (content check).

trading-portal-pages.description: GitHub Pages site: commit+push via GitHub Contents API to main, then scripts/deploy_portal.py --live assembles the gh-pages branch (main + canonical holiday JSON); Pages serves gh-pages, main is source-only.
